'''Alberto Bressan''' (born 15 June 1956) is an Italian [[mathematician]] at [[Penn State University]]. His primary field of research is [[mathematical analysis]] including [[hyperbolic system]]s of [[Conservation law (physics)|conservation law]]s, [[impulsive control]] of [[Lagrangian system]]s, and non-cooperative [[differential game]]s.

==Education and career==
Bressan was born in [[Venice]] on 15 June 1956. After earning a [[laurea]] (the Italian equivalent of a master's degree) in 1978 from the [[University of Padua]],<ref name=cv>{{cite web|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090824033710/http://www.math.psu.edu/bressan/PSPDF/bressan_cv.pdf|archive-date=2009-08-24|url=http://www.math.psu.edu/bressan/PSPDF/bressan_cv.pdf|url-status=dead|title=Curriculum vitae|date=July 2009}}</ref> he obtained his [[PhD]] in mathematics from the [[University of Colorado at Boulder]] under the supervision of [[Jerrold Bebernes]] in 1982.<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=44360 }}</ref>

After postdoctoral research at the University of Padua and the Mathematics Research Center of the [[University of Wisconsin-Madison]], he became an associate professor at the University of Colorado at Boulder in 1986. Bressan received a full professorship at the [[International School for Advanced Studies|SISSA]] in Trieste, Italy in 1991. In 2003, he moved to [[Penn State University]] to assume a full professorship there.<ref name=cv/>

==Recognition==
He won the [[Bôcher Memorial Prize]] in 2008<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ams.org/prizes/bocher-prize.html|title=Bocher Memorial Prize|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|accessdate=23 January 2010}}</ref> and the Analysis of Partial Differential Equations Prize of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|SIAM]] in 2007 for his work in [[Partial differential equation|PDEs]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.siam.org/prizes/sponsored/siagapde.php|title=SIAM: SIAG/Analysis of Partial Differential Equations Prize|website=www.siam.org|access-date=2017-02-16}}</ref> He was appointed to the Eberly Family Chair in Mathematics at Penn State in September 2007.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.science.psu.edu/news-and-events/2008-news/bressan8-2008.htm/|title=Alberto Bressan is Named Holder of the Eberly Family Chair in Mathematics|date=August 2008|publisher=[[Pennsylvania State University]]|accessdate=23 January 2010|archive-date=8 March 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120308224724/http://science.psu.edu/news-and-events/2008-news/bressan8-2008.htm/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In addition to the above, his honors include the ''[[Feltrinelli Prize|A. Feltrinelli prize]] for Mathematics, Mechanics and Applications'' of the [[Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei]] in Rome.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.science.psu.edu/news-and-events/2006-news/Bressan9-2006.htm|title=Bressan Awarded Antonio Feltrinelli Prize|date=2006-09-26|publisher=[[Pennsylvania State University]]|accessdate=23 January 2010|archive-date=2012-03-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120308224807/http://science.psu.edu/news-and-events/2006-news/Bressan9-2006.htm|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2012-11-10.</ref>

Bressan was invited to give a [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|plenary talk at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] at Beijing in August 2002.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mathunion.org/o/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1950|publisher=[[International Mathematical Union]]|accessdate=23 January 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100802230118/http://www.mathunion.org/o/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php|archive-date=2 August 2010|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mathunion.org/Videos/ICM2002/muster.php?Bressan_Alberto|title=Hyperbolic Systems of Conservation Laws in One Space Dimension|last=Bressan|first=Alberto|date=2002-08-26|work=Video|publisher=[[International Mathematical Union]]|accessdate=23 January 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110607064402/http://www.mathunion.org/Videos/ICM2002/muster.php?Bressan_Alberto|archive-date=7 June 2011|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}</ref>
